title: Constraint
description: Floor/step/min-qty adjustment applied after the build-up (MOLV, MOV, SPU rounding, MOQ). MROQ is deliberately absent here — it is routing input that selects a scenario before pricing runs, not a constraint (see requirements §5.1).

mode.description: kind=FLOOR only. Real MOLV behavior genuinely differs by region/source: PRICE (default if omitted) recalculates the unit price at the existing quantity to meet the floor; QUANTITY instead recalculates the order quantity at the existing unit price. Config-driven, not universal — see CLAUDE.md Decision Log topic 5.

min.description: Literal floor value for kind=FLOOR (e.g. MOLV), or minimum quantity for kind=MIN_QTY (e.g. MOQ).
